fat_pct.quote: * traditional, 30-d, Auvergne: **27.78 (±2.05) %, g/100g cheese**, source above

ph.quote: * traditional, 30-d, Auvergne: **5.66 (±0.12), pH unit**, source above

ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination at 1 mo with soluble protein ~1.9 g/100g, low NH3 accumulation.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasture-derived p-cresol/indole plus Brevibacterium/rind flora metabolism in farmhouse raw-milk cellar ripening.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin alpha-s1 casein proteolysis, balanced by high moisture.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti added; only trace 2-heptanone/2-nonanone from natural rind flora.

browning.reason: Maillard between residual lactose/galactose and lysine on heating in 1-mo high-moisture paste.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate metabolism in uncooked curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids from lipolysis and leucine catabolism; GC-O vomit-cheesy-feet peaks.

creaminess.reason: 27.78% fat, ~52% FDM with 46.5% moisture and 1-mo proteolysis giving coating mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: High-moisture pressed uncooked paste is supple-pliable with minimal fracture.

firmness.reason: Pressed uncooked paste at 46.5% moisture gives supple semi-hard body, not hard.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylethyl alcohol from phenylalanine catabolism identified as rose-floral GC-O peak.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/ethyl hexanoate from microbial esterase esterification of FFA with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks goaty 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids; only trace short-chain FFA.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal and 2-methylpropanal Strecker aldehydes from Leu/Val giving chocolate-nutty notes.

melt.reason: pH 5.66 rennet gel with intact para-casein flows on heating, good for pressed uncooked cheese.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol and 2-nonanone from rind Mucor/Geotrichum linoleic acid lipoxygenase oxidation; cellar signature.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free oil release from uncooked fat globules on heating, not excessive.

smoky.reason: No smoking step; no guaiacol/volatile phenols expected.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic plus acetic acids from mesophilic starter; acetic identified as vinegar GC-O peak at pH 5.66.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; rennet curd shows flow without stringing.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methional/methanethiol from Met catabolism; uncooked curd with no cooked-milk sulfides.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/galactose plus proline and buttery diacetyl masking acidity.

umami.reason: Moderate glutamate from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis and water-soluble N accumulation.
